results.raw_hits_note: Approximate count of reqs touched at board level across the 3 parallel collection forks, summed from each fork's reported per-source req counts (Datadog 382, Cloudflare 470, Stripe 787, Okta 362, Zscaler 377, GitLab 253, Canonical 316, Grafana Labs 136, Reddit 145, Palantir 302, Crusoe 318, Octopus/Kraken 163, Epic Games 139, DigiCert 52, plus smaller boards and multiple Leidos/Workday searchText sweeps). This undercounts true scan volume since not every individual JD within large boards was opened — only keyword/title-matched candidates were read in full.
results.collection_method_note: Three collection forks ran in parallel, each scoped to a disjoint slice of resources/sources.md: (1) cloud-native tech + Seattle-area majors, (2) energy-sector + Palantir/Leidos, (3) newly-formalized/promising-leads/aggregators + a fresh discovery sweep for brand-new sources. Each fork performed its own Step 3.5 live-URL validation inline (ATS JSON API primary, WebFetch fallback) and did not write any files or commit. The orchestrating main thread compiled all 3 forks' qualifying roles (23 total, no cross-fork duplicates this run), curated to 14 for quality/redundancy, re-verified all 5 top picks live a second time (Step 6), wrote the report/log, updated resources/sources.md, attempted the dashboard update, and committed.

token_usage.note: Exact figures for all 3 collection forks, taken directly from their completion notifications. Main-thread usage is not measurable precisely; proxy below.

main_thread_tool_calls_estimate.note: Main thread (orchestrator) made 5 curl/API calls for the Step 6 top-pick re-verification. All primary collection/filtering/Step-3.5 validation was performed by the 3 forks above. Main thread read sources.md/workflow/prior logs, compiled/curated 23 qualifying roles down to 14, wrote the report/log, edited resources/sources.md, and handled the dashboard update and commit.

timing.step3_3.5_filter_and_validation_minutes_: done inline during collection by each fork, not separately timed
timing.note: step2 wall-clock time approximated from the longest-running fork's duration_ms (~284s); the 3 forks ran concurrently rather than sequentially, so this is far less than the sum of their individual durations (~11 min serial equivalent).
